author: @bitgamma

evidence.api_compatibility: This is a positive change in API compatibility: the `/images/edit` endpoint now succeeds instead of returning a 500 unsupported error. Two models in server_models.json gained the "edit" label. The version bump in backend_versions.json changes the thenoise-rocm binary from 0.4.1 to 0.7.1, which may affect users' installed bundles. The ROCm GPU family expansion in thenoise.h and backends-reference.md adds gfx103X, gfx110X, and gfx120X to the supported list — this is backward compatible.
evidence.documentation: README.md updated the thenoise description from 'Supported AMD ROCm iGPU families' to 'Supported AMD ROCm families'. docs/dev/backends-reference.md was updated with the expanded GPU list. The backend header file comment was updated. No dedicated guide or example for the new `/images/edit` endpoint was added, but the existing image generation documentation serves as a template for this similar operation.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The `/images/edit` endpoint is a new user-reachable API surface (previously it returned an unsupported error). No commit message, test, or PR comment shows that anyone exercised this endpoint with real image data. The thenoise binary version bumps from 0.4.1 to 0.7.1, which is a major upgrade — the edit functionality is a new feature in the upstream library, not in the previous release. This is the primary reason for the verdict.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The PR had six commits authored by @bitgamma between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-09, and the final approval came at 2026-09-14. The merge queue bot merged at 2026-09-14T20:53:57Z. The branch was stable from approval to merge.
evidence.review: PR #3494 was authored by @bitgamma (subject-matter expert for TheNoise per contribute.md). @kenvandine approved with 'This looks good now, thanks for the clarifications' at 2026-09-14T20:07:05Z. No inline review comments were filed. No commits were added after approval. The reviewer is an admin maintainer with expertise in new backends and hardware vendor support, which covers the ROCm GPU family expansion and backend version bump.
evidence.security: The `image_edits` implementation forwards the request body to the thenoise `/edit` endpoint via `forward_request`, similar to the existing `image_generations` path. It copies `image_data` from the request and passes it through. No new credential handling, network calls outside the backend, or code execution paths are introduced. The upstream library version bump (0.4.1 → 0.7.1) should be verified for supply-chain integrity, but the code change itself is straightforward.
evidence.tests: The test `test_013_image_edits_unsupported` was removed because `/images/edit` is now supported. The test `test_014_image_variations_unsupported` was also removed even though `image_variations` still returns an UnsupportedOperationException — this appears to be a cleanup of a test that would have passed (the test verifies an error is returned, which the backend still does). No new test was added for the now-supported `/images/edit` endpoint. The PR relies on CI but there is no end-to-end test exercising the edit path.

maintainer_todos.text: Post a `/images/edit` request through the server with a valid model, prompt, and base64 image data, and confirm the endpoint returns b64_json in the response instead of an unsupported error.

subject: implement `/images/edit` in TheNoise (#3494)
summary: Implements `/images/edit` in TheNoise, upgrades the thenoise binary version from 0.4.1 to 0.7.1, expands supported ROCm GPU families, and adds the "edit" label to server models.
verdict_reason: The new `/images/edit` API surface has no evidence of manual end-to-end validation before merge.
